The '''Gravestone bandits''' were a group of criminals active on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they were led by [[Macz Cynthisa]].<ref name="SWG:FtMIC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Gravestone bandits attacked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Courier/Legends|courier]] near [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] and stole the missive he was carrying. Macz Cynthisa later intended to sell the Imperial data to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Cynthisa and a group of Gravestone bandits thus encountered a squad of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Zyyacah Kolzaar]] in the [[Riverlands]]. However, the Imperial courier was working for [[Rogan Fel]], an agent of [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Loam Redge]]. The Inquisitor promptly dispatched a group of Imperial operatives to crash the meeting and recover the sensitive information. Most Gravestone bandits and Rebel troopers were killed in the brutal assault, including Macz Cynthisa and Major Kolzaar.<ref name="SWG:FtMIC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gravestone bandits appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtMIC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Gravestone bandits were added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:FtMIC" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
